feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 11 -- Compliance drill-downs: Open gaps (/portal-v2/compliance/open-gaps, isCmpGaps 4659-4730), Documented policy decisions (/compliance/decisions, isCmpDecisions 4732-4781) and Obligations we check against (/compliance/obligations, isCmpObligations 4783-4814). UI-only, design fixtures in cmpDrilldownData.ts (CMP_FINDINGS / CMP_ACCEPTED / CMP_OBLIGATIONS); the counts, accepted-meta pairs and obligation tone map are pinned by cmpDrilldownModel.test.ts. A gap's wrench opens the shared FixPanel and 'Record a policy decision instead' opens the shared FormDrawer. Reached from the Compliance pillar; no top-level nav rows.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL -- see the shared portal manifest note. With only the two #email/#password input steps red on a persisted session and every page assertion green, that is a PASS.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: real URL is /portal/shane-mccaw-consulting/portal-v2/compliance/<slug>. Two-segment routes declared at the App.tsx marker; '/portal-v2/:pillar' cannot swallow them.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build -- these routes are new in Part 11, so a run against a build predating the deploy fails at the first assertion (a not-deployed signal, not a page defect).

REAL INTERACTION DRIVEN: expand a gap (CMP4-CMP5) reveals the obligation, evidence and both actions; the wrench and 'Record a policy decision instead' open the shared FixPanel / FormDrawer, asserted as RENDERING.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
